court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondent(s) : Mr. G. Saravanan for Sole Respondent
judgment_text:
Prayer : This Civil Miscellaneous second appeal is filed under Section 28 of Hindu Marriage Act r/s Section 100 CPC, to set aside the fair and decreetal order dated 3-2-2025 made in CMA. No. 3 of 2024 on the file of the learned II Additional District Judge of Tiruchengode confirming the fair and decreetal order dated 22-12-2023 made in HMOP. No. 138 of 2021 on the file of Honble Sub Court, Tiruchengode.

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

K. Govindarajan Thilakavadi, J.:— This Civil Miscellaneous second appeal is filed against judgment and decree dated 3-2-2025 made in CMA. No. 3 of 2024 on the file of the learned II Additional District Judge of Tiruchengode confirming the fair and decreetal order dated 22-12-2023 made in HMOP. No. 138 of 2021 on the file of Honble Sub Court, Tiruchengode.

2. With the consent of both the parties the matter was referred to the Tamil Nadu Mediation and Conciliation Centre, High Court of Madras, for arriving at an amicable settlement between the parties. Accordingly, settlement was arrived at between the parties and a Mediation Report of the Tamil Nadu Mediation and Conciliation Centre, High Court of Madras, along with a Settlement agreement dated 30-4-2026 entered into between the parties, duly signed by both the parties and their counsels, is filed and the same is recorded.

3. The Civil Miscellaneous second appeal in C.M.S.A. No. 66 of 2025 is disposed of in accordance with the Settlement agreement arrived at between the parties in the Tamil Nadu Mediation and Conciliation Centre, High Court of Madras. The Settlement agreement shall form part of the decree in C.M.S.A. No. 66 of 2025. No costs.

4. The Court fee shall be refunded to the appellants as per rules.
